original_query: select min(i_item_sk)       ,min(w_warehouse_name)       ,min(d1.d_week_seq)       ,min(cs_item_sk)       ,min(cs_order_number)       ,min(inv_item_sk) from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '>10000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'W'   and cd_dep_count between 4 and 6   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37  ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(i.i_item_sk)        AS min_i_item_sk,
       MIN(w.w_warehouse_name) AS min_w_warehouse_name,
       MIN(d1.d_week_seq)      AS min_d1_week_seq,
       MIN(cs.cs_item_sk)      AS min_cs_item_sk,
       MIN(cs.cs_order_number) AS min_cs_order_number,
       MIN(inv.inv_item_sk)    AS min_inv_item_sk
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON d1.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
 AND d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
 AND d2.d_year = 2001
JOIN date_dim d3
  ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
WHERE d1.d_year = 2001
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6
  AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
  AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Removed the LEFT OUTER JOIN to promotion (p_promo_sk): no p_ columns appear in SELECT/WHERE/GROUP BY, and the global MIN aggregate is invariant under duplicate-row multiplication, so the join is redundant. Score 10/10.
Removed the LEFT OUTER JOIN to catalog_returns (~2.16M rows): no cr_ columns are referenced and duplicates do not change MIN results. Eliminates a large join and potential row explosion. Score 10/10.

Added d2.d_year = 2001: in TPC-DS d_week_seq is a globally unique week sequence, so combined with d1.d_year = 2001 and d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq, this predicate is logically implied; it lets the optimizer prune date_dim d2 (73k rows) down to ~365 rows before the hash join. Score 7/10.
Moved d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq from WHERE into the d2 JOIN ON clause for clearer join semantics and better join-condition locality. Score 3/10 (readability/optimizer hint).

No CTE used: the query is a single global aggregate with no repeated subexpressions; a CTE would add materialization/planning overhead without benefit. Avoid splitting the MINs into multiple scans. Score N/A (design decision).
